title: Sherlock Holmes: A Study in Scarlet — Ep 06/14 — "Tobias Gregson Shows What He Can Do"
description:
A Study in Scarlet, Episode 6. Gregson arrives at Baker Street certain he has solved it.

Told in Watson's own voice, cut to under three minutes. The morning papers are full of the Brixton Mystery and every one of them is certain. Six ragged street boys come up the stairs to report and go away again with a shilling each. Then Tobias Gregson comes down the road with beatitude on every feature, takes the armchair and a cigar, and tells how he traced a dead man's hat to a Camberwell boarding house — and arrested a young naval officer with a stout oak cudgel still on him.

Holmes listens, and says well done, and we shall make something of you yet.

Then Lestrade comes up the stairs with his collar askew.

Chapter VI of Arthur Conan Doyle's A Study in Scarlet (1887), in the public domain.

— The Keeper's Lantern —
Every episode is one whole chapter, in order, from the first page to the last.
